test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Slightly ______ bitter oranges to remove the red color which covers their skins.
solution: The correct answer is **"grate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Grate" **means to shred or scrape something into small pieces using a grater or similar tool. (खाद्य पदार्थों को कद्दूकस पर घिसना या कसना) • **Example**: *Would you **grate**__ the cheese?* • In this context, the oranges are being grated slightly to remove the red color on their skins. • The verb **"grate"** is being used in the present tense. • The adverb **"slightly"** modifies the verb** "grate."** • The correct answer is Option 2. **Correct sentence**: *Slightly __**grate**__ bitter oranges to remove the red color which covers their skins.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 1, "grace"**, means elegance or beauty. It is not the correct word to use in this context. (व्यवस्थित तथा अनुशासित चेष्‍टा-क्षमता; लालित्‍य) • **Option 3, "great"**, means large or impressive. It is not the correct word to use in this context. (मात्रा, आकार आदि में बड़ा; बहुत अधिक) • **Option 4, "grade"**, means to classify something according to its quality or rank. It is not the correct word to use in this context. (गुणवत्ता, योग्‍यता, आकार आदि के अनुसार वस्‍तुओं या व्‍यक्तियों का वर्गीकरण; श्रेणीकरण) 1a3:T792, Here, the erroneous part is **"work, most beautiful than going."**
